LanguageData.LP_Setting_ChildcarePlay: Adults play with children as Childcare
LanguageData.LP_Setting_ChildcarePlayTip: When on, an adult assigned to Childcare goes to a child playing alone. On shared rides (swing, seesaw, sandbox, roundabout, playhouse, large trampoline) the adult takes the free seat and plays along; next to solo rides the adult stands and watches. Like playing with a baby, the adult gains a little social recreation. When off, adults only join children during their own recreation.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RecordPlayTip: When on, every ride is logged: who rode, with whom, who watched, how they came, and why a shared ride was used alone. See a ride's info panel or use View log below; the same lines are written to the file below.

LanguageData.LP_Setting_FacialPlayTip: Use an existing smile only when the installed Facial Animation face pack supports it. Switch off to disconnect Little Playgrounds immediately; other facial animations keep working. No new face textures are added.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_FacialPlayError: Facial connection stopped after an error. Switch this option off and on to retry.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_SoundsTip: Small sounds while playing: swings creak, trampolines bounce, sand and water play, the drinking fountain. You hear them only when zoomed in close; they follow the game's sound volume and stay quiet while the game is paused. The slides and the ball pit have no sound.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RunAround: Children sometimes run around a ride instead of riding it
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RunAroundTip: A child who has picked a ride may run around it instead, and learns as much as from a swing ride. On shared rides a friend joins in; otherwise an adult assigned to Childcare comes to watch. Needs dry open ground next to the ride (not water or mud), or the child simply rides.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RunAroundChance: Chance each time a child picks a ride: {0}
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RunAroundIndoorsTip: When off, children only run on open ground, so rides indoors are simply ridden; a playground canopy does not count as a roof. When on, they also run around indoor rides if the room has space.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_CouplePlayTip: An adult who picks a ride or bench two can share calls their love partner, who comes if free or between ordinary tasks, and a couple with nothing to do sometimes goes on a date by themselves, at most once a day. They wait for each other, and afterwards both get a small mood and opinion bonus.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_RequireResearchTip: When on, everything this mod adds (rides, benches, fences and floors) can be built only after {0} is researched. The usual starts already have it, so only colonies that begin without it, such as tribes, research it first. Anything already built stays. When off, everything can be built from the start.
LanguageData.LP_Setting_ToddlerPlayTip: With the Toddlers mod, toddlers who can walk, wobbly ones included, play on these rides: {0}. Crawling toddlers stay off. When off, toddlers leave every ride alone. Without the Toddlers mod this does nothing.
